q: How much CO2 does washing and drying silica sand add per tonne?
title: Silica sand washing CO2 per tonne
short: Washing and screening run on electricity, and the dryer burns fuel to take moisture out. Add kWh times 0.710 kg CO2 and the dryer fuel at IPCC defaults, then divide by tonnes of dry sand dispatched. Wetter feed means more dryer fuel per tonne.
audience: Silica sand processors supplying glass, foundry and construction

ul: Electricity for washing, attrition and screening.
Dryer fuel: diesel, LPG, coal or biomass.
Tonnes of dry sand dispatched and moisture of the feed.

p: Glass makers count your figure in their Scope 3. Give it per tonne dry with the moisture basis stated.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
